title: Case: Duplicate delivery service charge appears on a business invoice
context: Two invoice lines have the same shipment, service and date. The authorised billing team must confirm duplication and issue a credit note and revised balance.
initial_request: Please ask billing to review the duplicate before we pay this invoice. We have not paid either line.

events.from: Orla Kinsella, Foxhallow Press finance coordinator
events.body: Inline invoice INV-8885: line 1 delivery service DL-9992, 2028-03-19, GBP 18.00; line 2 delivery service DL-9992, 2028-03-19, GBP 18.00; invoice total GBP 36.00. Both lines have the same service key. No separate service is listed.

events.from: Orla Kinsella, Foxhallow Press finance coordinator
events.body: Please ask billing to review the duplicate before we pay this invoice. We have not paid either line.

events.from: Greer Yardley, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-9992 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.

events.from: Orla Kinsella, Foxhallow Press finance coordinator
events.body: Please ask billing to review the duplicate before we pay this invoice. We have not paid either line.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's authorised billing team to review the two matching charge lines.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Dappleford Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's authorised billing team to review the two matching charge lines. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: A credit note is an accounting adjustment, not cash received. GBP 36.00 minus GBP 18.00 equals GBP 18.00 due.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
Treats the claim from Greer Yardley (who has no recorded link to DL-9992) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Greer Yardley's message
expected.reference_message: Please review INV-8885’s two GBP 18.00 lines for the same DL-9992 delivery service and date. If duplication is confirmed, issue the authorised credit and revised invoice balance.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-049: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. An unverified bystander, Greer Yardley, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
